verses.text: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
verses.line: 1:And when the sabbath was past Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James and Salome bought spices that they might come and anoint him

verses.text: And very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb when the sun was risen.
verses.line: 2:And very early on the first day of the week they come to the tomb when the sun was risen

verses.text: And they were saying among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the tomb?
verses.line: 3:And they were saying among themselves Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the tomb

verses.text: and looking up, they see that the stone is rolled back: for it was exceeding great.
verses.line: 4:and looking up they see that the stone is rolled back for it was exceeding great

verses.text: And entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, arrayed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
verses.line: 5:And entering into the tomb they saw a young man sitting on the right side arrayed in a white robe and they were amazed

verses.text: And he saith unto them, Be not amazed: ye seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who hath been crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold, the place where they laid him!
verses.line: 6:And he saith unto them Be not amazed ye seek Jesus the Nazarene who hath been crucified he is risen he is not here behold the place where they laid him

verses.text: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, He goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
verses.line: 7:But go tell his disciples and Peter He goeth before you into Galilee there shall ye see him as he said unto you

verses.text: And they went out, and fled from the tomb; for trembling and astonishment had come upon them: and they said nothing to any one; for they were afraid.
verses.line: 8:And they went out and fled from the tomb for trembling and astonishment had come upon them and they said nothing to any one for they were afraid

verses.text: Now when he was risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
verses.line: 9:Now when he was risen early on the first day of the week he appeared first to Mary Magdalene from whom he had cast out seven demons

verses.text: She went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
verses.line: 10:She went and told them that had been with him as they mourned and wept

verses.text: And they, when they heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, disbelieved.
verses.line: 11:And they when they heard that he was alive and had been seen of her disbelieved

verses.text: And after these things he was manifested in another form unto two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
verses.line: 12:And after these things he was manifested in another form unto two of them as they walked on their way into the country

verses.text: And they went away and told it unto the rest: neither believed they them.
verses.line: 13:And they went away and told it unto the rest neither believed they them

verses.text: And afterward he was manifested unto the eleven themselves as they sat at meat; and he upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them that had seen him after he was risen.
verses.line: 14:And afterward he was manifested unto the eleven themselves as they sat at meat and he upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart because they believed not them that had seen him after he was risen

verses.text: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
verses.line: 15:And he said unto them Go ye into all the world and preach the gospel to the whole creation

verses.text: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that disbelieveth shall be condemned.
verses.line: 16:He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved but he that disbelieveth shall be condemned

verses.text: And these signs shall accompany them that believe: in my name shall they cast out demons; they shall speak with new tongues;
verses.line: 17:And these signs shall accompany them that believe in my name shall they cast out demons they shall speak with new tongues

verses.text: they shall take up serpents, and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall in no wise hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
verses.line: 18:they shall take up serpents and if they drink any deadly thing it shall in no wise hurt them they shall lay hands on the sick and they shall recover

verses.text: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken unto them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
verses.line: 19:So then the Lord Jesus after he had spoken unto them was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God

verses.text: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
verses.line: 20:And they went forth and preached everywhere the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed Amen
